jobs.occupation: Atr - technician operating and maintaining atr pedagogic tools (f/m) (h/f) (H/F)
jobs.description: Job Description:  About us ATR is the world's number one aircraft manufacturer in regional aviation providing a new generation of turboprops. We are a joint venture between two European aeronautical heavyweights, Airbus and Leonardo.From the world's largest cities, to our planet's most remote regions, our purpose is to deliver air travel to people, communities and businesses in an innovative, sustainable and modern way.If you strive for excellence, are driven by ambition, trust and respect as we are, then get your career off to a flighting start with ATR!Our leadership profile:People Centric  Entrepreneurial  Inspiring  Exemplary  Innovative  HumbleAt ATR you will work with passionate colleagues to make a difference in a human size company with attractive advantages!We are looking for a Technician operating and maintaining ATR pedagogic tools to come onboard in our Customer Support and Services Directorate in Samy's team.Your Mission -  In compliance with applicable regulations, ATR training programs and industry standards, ensure the proper functioning and fidelity of the ATR Training Center's teaching tools on an autonomous basis 24 hours a day, 365 days a year.-  Under the supervision of the STTM Maintenance Manager, participate in the continuous improvement of STT's technical service methods, processes, knowledge and tools.-  Outside office hours, provide the ATC customer interface with other services (sales/planning, quality, safety, etc.) and find solutions to problems expressed (planning, safety, etc.).Record, analyze and correct technical hardware and software anomalies found on ATR Training Center training tools.Carry out preventive and curative maintenance tasks on training tools by capitalizing on experience feedback via STT CMMSEnsure the passage of instructions during team changesDecide and assume responsibility for an interruption of a session, the duration of repairs, the delay or re-planning of a session on another simulatorOutside office hours, organize the activities of the companies providing on-call services (air conditioning, electricity, security, etc.).Outside office hours, manage and monitor the first-level maintenance services of ATR teaching tools.Participate in the certification of simulators. About you -  Experience : 2 years-  Technical skills / knowledge : Electronics, electricity, automation, industrial computing, mechanics, optics, aeronautics and knowledge of the ATR aircraft.-  Soft skills : Autonomy, teamwork skills, involvement, irreproachable behavior.-  Fluent in English and French (Italian is a plus) -  ... but above all, you are ready to take off with us to keep connecting communities and businesses and provide the best possible products and support to our customers! Our Recruitment Process -  Samy will contact you-  Innovative and digital assessment-  To get to know you better: interview with Samy then with our Hr Recruiter.What we offer Highly competitive compensation package (profit and success sharing, employee savings plan...)Work-life balance (remote working, 6th week of paid leave, additional days off for family events...) Well-being / health (supplementary health & welfare coverage...)  Career paths enabling employees to develop their skills and build a professional project  Wide choice of development programs forsoft and hard skills  CSE: ATR (family and employee events) and Airbus CSE (travel, vacation camps ...) Diversity and inclusion: Over 1400 men & women with more than 35 different nationalities work together in our teams !ATR is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------  A propos d'ATR ATR est le premier constructeur mondial d'avions régionaux et propose une nouvelle génération de turbopropulseurs. Nous sommes une filiale de deux poids lourds de l'aéronautique européenne, Airbus et Leonardo.Des plus grandes villes du monde aux régions les plus reculées de notre planète, notre objectif est d'assurer le transport aérien des personnes, des communautés et des entreprises d'une manière innovante, durable et moderne.Si vous recherchez l'excellence, si vous êtes animé par l'ambition, la confiance et le respect, alors faites décoller votre carrière avec ATR !Notre Leadership Profile :Centré(e) sur l'humain un esprit entrepreneur inspirant(e) exemplaire innovant(e) humbleVous travaillerez avec des collègues passionnés pour faire la différence dans une entreprise à taille humaine avec des avantages attractifs !Nous recherchons un Technicien chargé de l'exploitation et de la maintenance des outils pédagogiques
